none: PAS NLM-2A28E3: Roman Coin: Radiate of Tetricus I from Roxby cum Risby
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Radiate, possibly of Tetricus I (271-274), Reece period 13. Obverse description: radiate bust right. Obverse inscription: [IMP] C T[---]]TRI[--]. Reverse description: Helmeted figure standing left, possibly Virtus. Reverse inscription: [VIR]TVS A[VG]. Diameter: 19.4mm, Weight: 2.34gms, die axis: 12
